question: If assets of a bank are greater than liabilities, it will be recorded as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**net worth**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Net worth is a financial metric that represents the overall value of an individual, company, or entity.
 
• It's calculated by subtracting total liabilities from total assets.
 
• A positive net worth indicates financial health, while a negative one signifies debt exceeding assets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Assets: **

 
 
• These are items of value owned by an individual or entity, such as real estate, vehicles, investments, bank accounts, and personal belongings.
 
 
 
• **Liabilities: **
 
 
• These are financial obligations or debts, including mortgages, loans, credit card debt, and other outstanding payments.
